name: Manus
summary: General-purpose AI agent that executes tasks end to end.
description: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that goes beyond answering questions to carry out tasks such as in-depth research, building websites and producing slides. It stands out for parallel 'Wide Research' and scheduled tasks running in the cloud. A free plan gives 300 daily refresh credits (Lite agent mode, capped monthly) plus signup credits, and paid plans add monthly credit pools from 4,000 credits.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan gives 300 daily refresh credits (Lite agent mode, capped monthly) plus signup credits, and paid plans add monthly credit pools from 4,000 credits.

howToUse.title: Sign up and tell Manus the task
howToUse.description: The homepage asks what it can do for you, with starters for slides, a website, games, video, and design.

howToUse.title: Pick a starter or type your own request
howToUse.description: The visible starters are Create slides, Build website, Create games, Video, and Design.

howToUse.description: Docs and the help center are linked from the page.
